title: GNU C Library — System Databases and Name Service Switch

date.notes: Current glibc manual reviewed in 2026; wording also appears in older glibc manuals.

claims_extracted.claim: glibc NSS was designed after the Solaris 2 C library method and intentionally uses the same Name Service Switch name.
glibc documentation explicitly states there is no common code with Sun's implementation and the internal interface is incompatible.

notes: Primary project documentation distinguishing design influence from source-code ancestry.
